column2: N-no! I never imagined that armor's power could be so great!!
Now that you understand the strength of the $$大邪神$$ armor, it is time you told us...
where the remaining $$大邪神$$ armors are!
What?! There are more armors like that?!
Exactly! The $$大邪神$$ armor is named for the $$七大邪神$$,
and there are seven of them in this $$世界$$!!
$$ユダ$$, ensnared by power as you are... you must have found out where they are!
All right... I will tell you! I'll talk!
As far as I know, the rulers of $$カナン$$ and $$パンデモニウム$$ bought them secretly from the $$教団$$...
and are supposed to be keeping them.
The $$教団$$? You mean the same largest organization that captured us...
the biggest organization in this $$世界$$, the $$アンゲルス教団$$?!
$$おにいちゃん$$...
N-no... Sorry! It's nothing...
That is why even I could not lay a hand on them, under orders from the upper ranks.
That is all I know,
I swear it is true!!
(Amazing...! I might even...)
(I might find the $$自由$$ I have been seeking.)
And one more thing.
The person dear to this fellow, who was caught by the $$異端審問官$$ for talking about $$愛$$...
where did they take this fellow's $$飼い主$$?!
The $$異端審問会$$ is the direct unit of the $$アンゲルス教$$'s $$総本山$$!
But even I do not know where the $$総本山$$ is!
What's this $$総本山$$ you're talking about?
It is the $$教皇庁$$, which stands above every church on this continent!
It governs all of the Church's doctrine and order,
I had heard rumors myself,
but I had never cared much, so I do not know the details!!
$$神官$$s in this city only ever had their minds on their own research, after all.
From there...
orders sometimes came from the noble one called the $$教皇$$,
but that is all I know. Aren't we done already?!
$$おにいちゃん$$, $$おにいちゃん$$! That person must be just like $$レブ$$, too...
He's got bugs living in his head!
What did you say?!
So in the end, we still do not know where the person precious to that boy who talks about $$愛$$ has gone...
I've decided! I am going to stick with this fellow a little longer!!
That way, I may find what I am looking for sooner, too.
What's this... thing you're looking for?
Something you musclehead will never understand for all eternity...
Tch, it's probably nothing worthwhile anyway.
Nyeah, nyeah! Musclehead!
Shut it, meat thief!
I'm weak too... but I want to go with everyone.
Whether gathering intelligence or rescuing this fellow's $$御主人$$,
in $$この世$$, strength is everything!
First, we must grow strong!!
With our present $$戦力$$, we would merely be walking to our deaths.
What will you do?
I only want to rescue my sister...
I only want to rescue my brother...
I have no intention of cozying up to you lot, but...
in this situation... I suppose it cannot be helped.
Then how about we all go to $$パンデモニウム$$, the city where I used to live?!
If $$お師匠さま$$ is going, then of course I will accompany him!
No, but your health...
D-do as you like!
Settled, then!! Well, no knowing how long it will last, but...
I'll keep your backs safe on the road!
Heh, can't say I trust you at all.
Everyone, don't ever stand in front of this guy.
Tch. What a suspicious bastard.
With everyone here, I'm sure it will be okay!!
Hey, hey, $$ガイ$$ told me earlier,
They say you believe in $$愛$$ too?!
